title: The open gaps of the claude, mcp and prior-art articles, and the entries that name no topic are researched from official sources or noted with what was tried
goal: every _gaps.md entry open on 2026-10-20 whose first topic is under the claude, mcp and prior-art articles, and the entries that name no topic is researched into its article from official sources and closed with a Resolved or Partly resolved note citing them, or carries a Tried note dated 2026-10-21 or later saying what was searched and what source, lab or login would answer it; an entry asking for a count or list a kb tool answers is closed naming the tool; no fact is deleted

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
L, P, F = 'public/_gaps.md', ('claude/', 'mcp/', 'prior-art/', '?'), '2026-10-21'
N = re.compile(r'\b(?:Looked|Tried|Still open|Resolved|Reviewed|Closed|Narrowed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Superseded):? (20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)')
C = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s)- (?:Resolved|Superseded|Closed|Reviewed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Narrowed)\b')
es = kbfacts.ledger_entries(L)
kbfacts.link_entries(es)
top = lambda e: (e['explicit'] or e['via_sources'] or ['public/?'])[0].split('/', 1)[1]
left = [e['line'] for e in es if not C.search(e['text']) and top(e).startswith(P) and max(N.findall(e['text']) or ['0']) < F]
print(len(left), 'open', L, 'entries under', P, 'with no note dated', F, 'or later, lines:', left[:25])
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

notes: Research item (/kb-research). Operator 2026-10-20: all open gaps, including those already tried: each gets a fresh search (live docs, then the web) and a dated note; a gap that still needs a lab, a login or unpublished information stays open as state.
